name: caisse_v1_order_quote
episode_body: Caisse V1 M-05 closed in GPT-only mode: OrderQuoteService now creates signed backend quotes and the real POS/Kiosk commit paths seal and consume the quote with consumed_order_id. Durable decision: POS and kiosk may accept legacy requests without quote_token by generating a server-side commit quote, but client-supplied quote_token/signature must pass TTL, HMAC, intent and branch checks. Main files: app/Services/Order/OrderQuoteService.php, app/Services/OrderService.php, app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php, POS/Kiosk quote UI and quote tests. Tests green: php artisan test --filter=Quote => 11 passed; POS/Kiosk/payment regression pack => 37 passed; kioskCart vitest => 12 passed. Gates: schema Option A and payment prop Option A approved. SYMMETRY_NOTE: OrderService::posOrderStore and FrontendOrderService::myOrderStore both call OrderQuoteService::sealForCommit before save/dispatch. CLOSE: 2026-04-25.
